sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Energy Flow**: Ecosystems are **open systems** for energy (unidirectional) and **closed systems** for matter (cyclic). Energy follows the **Second Law of Thermodynamics** (entropy increases, energy quality degrades).
• **Productivity**: The rate of biomass production. **GPP (Gross Primary Productivity)** is total organic matter synthesized; **NPP (Net Primary Productivity)** is GPP minus respiration losses (NPP = GPP - R).
• **Decomposition**: The breakdown of complex organic matter into inorganic substances (CO2, water, nutrients) by **detritivores** and **decomposers**.
• **Key Metric**: **Trophic Efficiency** (Lindeman’s 10% Law) dictates that only 10% of energy is transferred to the next trophic level.

items.definition: The movement of nutrients (Carbon, Nitrogen, Phosphorus) through biotic and abiotic components. Gaseous cycles (N, C) have atmospheric reservoirs; Sedimentary cycles (P, S) have crustal reservoirs.
Benefits humans derive from ecosystems: Provisioning (food/water), Regulating (climate/disease), Supporting (nutrient cycling), and Cultural (spiritual/recreational).

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **TEEB (The Economics of Ecosystems and Biodiversity)**: Global initiative to make nature's values visible.
• **PES (Payment for Ecosystem Services)**: Economic incentive mechanism for conservation.

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Key Challenges**: Habitat fragmentation, invasive species, and climate-induced shifts in phenology.
• **Solutions**: Nature-based Solutions (NbS) and Ecosystem-based Adaptation (EbA).

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'P-R-D-E' (Productivity, Respiration, Decomposition, Energy Flow).
• **Decoded Meaning**: The four pillars of ecosystem function.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Standing Crop' (biomass at a time) with 'Productivity' (rate of biomass production). Also, remember that the Pyramid of Energy is the ONLY pyramid that is always upright.
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Ecological Integrity' when discussing ecosystem health and 'Trophic Cascade' when discussing top-down control in food webs.

keyTakeaways: Energy flow is unidirectional; nutrient cycling is cyclic.
NPP is the available biomass for heterotrophs.
Ecosystem services are the economic foundation of sustainable development.
